question.text: For the two circles $x^2+y^2=16$ and $x^2+y^2-2 y=0$, there is/are

solution.text:
Let, $x^2+y^2=16$ or $x^2+y^2=4^2$ radius of circle $r_1=4$, centre $\mathrm{C}_1(0,0)$ we have, $x^2+y^2-2 y=0$
$$
\begin{aligned}
\Rightarrow & x^2+\left(y^2-2 y+1\right)-1=0 \text { or } x^2+(y-1)^2 \\
=& 1^2
\end{aligned}
$$
Radius 1, centre $\mathrm{C}_2(0,1)$
$$
\begin{aligned}
&\left|C_1 C_2\right|=1 \\
&\left|r_2-r_1\right|=|4-1|=3 \\
&\left|C_1 C_2\right| < \left|r_2-r_1\right|
\end{aligned}
$$
no common tangents for these two circles.
